package_metadata.name: napari-cellposesam
package_metadata.summary: napari plugin for cellpose and Cellpose-SAM segmentation
package_metadata.description: # napari-cellposesam [![Documentation Status](https://readthedocs.org/projects/napari-cellposesam/badge/?version=latest)](https://napari-cellposesam.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) [![tests](https://github.com/jeskowagner/napari-cellposesam/actions/workflows/test_and_deploy.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/jeskowagner/napari-cellposesam/actions) [![PyPI version](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/napari-cellposesam)](https://pypi.org/project/napari-cellposesam/) [![Python version](https://img.shields.io/pypi/pyversions/napari-cellposesam)](https://pypi.org/project/napari-cellposesam/) [![License](https://img.shields.io/pypi/l/napari-cellposesam.svg?color=green)](https://github.com/jeskowagner/napari-cellposesam/raw/main/LICENSE) [![website](https://img.shields.io/website?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cellpose.org)](https://www.cellpose.org) A [napari] plugin for cell segmentation with [cellpose], including Cellpose-SAM (cellpose v4). This is a fork of [MouseLand/cellpose-napari](https://github.com/MouseLand/cellpose-napari), the original plugin by Carsen Stringer. It adds: - support for cellpose v4 and the Cellpose-SAM (`cpsam`) models, while still working with cellpose v3 - z/channel axis selection for 3D and 4D images - compatibility with new napari versions The cellpose code was written by Carsen Stringer and Marius Pachitariu. To learn about Cellpose, read the [**paper**](https://t.co/kBMXmPp3Yn?amp=1) or watch this [**talk**](https://t.co/JChCsTD0SK?amp=1). For problems with this plugin, open an [issue](https://github.com/jeskowagner/napari-cellposesam/issues). For problems with cellpose itself, open an [issue](https://github.com/MouseLand/cellpose/issues) on the cellpose repo. If you use this plugin, please cite the [cellpose paper](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-020-01018-x), and the Cellpose-SAM paper if you use the `cpsam` models (see the [cellpose repo](https://github.com/MouseLand/cellpose) for the reference): ```bibtex @article{stringer2021cellpose, title={Cellpose: a generalist algorithm for cellular segmentation}, author={Stringer, Carsen and Wang, Tim and Michaelos, Michalis and Pachitariu, Marius}, journal={Nature Methods}, volume={18}, number={1}, pages={100--106}, year={2021}, publisher={Nature Publishing Group} } ``` ![napari-cellposesam segmenting the 2D sample image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeskowagner/napari-cellposesam/main/docs/_static/gui.png) ## Installation Requires Python 3.11 or newer. We recommend a fresh environment, e.g. with conda: ``` conda create -n napari-cellposesam python=3.12 conda activate napari-cellposesam ``` Install napari and the plugin with pip: ``` pip install "napari[all]" napari-cellposesam ``` Or install the plugin from the napari plugin manager (Plugins > Install/Uninstall Plugins). To install the latest development version from GitHub: ``` pip install git+https://github.com/jeskowagner/napari-cellposesam ``` If you have issues installing cellpose, see the [cellpose installation docs](https://cellpose.readthedocs.io/en/latest/installation.html). ### GPU cellpose runs on CPU, NVIDIA GPUs (CUDA) and Apple silicon (MPS). For CUDA, install a CUDA build of torch following the [PyTorch instructions](https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/) before or after installing the plugin. The plugin uses the GPU automatically if torch can see one. ### Optional: CPDINO models The CPDINO models need [DINOv3](https://github.com/facebookresearch/dinov3), which is not on PyPI and so is not installed automatically. The plugin offers to install it when you run segmentation with a CPDINO model, or install it yourself: ``` pip install git+https://github.com/facebookresearch/dinov3 ``` Without it, cellpose logs a `Could not import CPDINO` warning on startup. This is harmless if you don't use those models. ### Upgrading ``` pip install --upgrade napari-cellposesam cellpose ``` ## Usage Open napari with the plugin docked: ``` napari -w napari-cellposesam ``` Sample data is available under File > Open Sample > napari-cellposesam. Detailed usage is described in the [documentation](https://napari-cellposesam.readthedocs.io/). ## Contributing Contributions are welcome. For development, clone the repo and install it in editable mode with the test dependencies: ``` pip install -e ".[testing]" pytest ``` ## License Distributed under the terms of the [BSD-3] license, "napari-cellposesam" is free and open source software. ## Dependencies napari-cellposesam relies on: - [napari](https://napari.org) - [magicgui](https://napari.org/magicgui/) - [cellpose], which in turn uses [torch](https://pytorch.org/), [numpy](https://numpy.org/), [scipy](https://scipy.org/), [opencv](https://opencv.org/) and others [napari]: https://github.com/napari/napari [cellpose]: https://github.com/MouseLand/cellpose [BSD-3]: http://opensource.org/licenses/BSD-3-Clause
